purpose: Mechanically classify SteamDB history cache coverage for the final stage-13 primary purchase variants before any new SteamDB lookup.

classification.confirmed_min_reuse: cache hit only when current price is not below cached nonzero minimum
classification.previously_free_reuse: cache hit for zero history without requery solely because of zero
classification.schema_2_unavailable_exact_history: negative_cache_hit only while checked_at_utc plus canonical TTL has not expired

pass_requires: every current primary key is classified exactly once
confirmed_min, previously_free, valid negative-cache hits, and true lookup misses are counted separately
zero SteamDB lookups occur in this stage
classification count equals stage 13 family count
